messages:
lia: PartnerFin raised a P1 — their integration started getting 500s and 1500ms+ tail latency on embeddings endpoints since 03:20 UTC. They say traffic routed to our Dedicated pool A (eu-west). SLA at risk if not mitigated within 2 hours. Can eng pick owners and a short workaround?

devon: copying eng-platform for visibility. Can someone confirm if pool A autoscale had any failures? I see some GPU nodes flapping in the last hour in the dashboard. :thinking_face:

maria: I can look. Checking autoscaler logs now. Quick ask: do we know if PartnerFin is using batch requests or single-embedding calls?

lia: they said single-embedding calls from their client, QPS ~120 steady with occasional spikes to 400. No recent deploys on their side.

aj: looked at autoscaler — one node rebooted due to kernel OOM around 03:12, then recovered. But we also hit high KV cache miss rate for embeddings-serving model v2. Cache miss correlates with p50->p99 spread. Might be hot-keys from PartnerFin.

devon: OK — shortlist mitigations: 1) temporarily reroute PartnerFin to Hosted fallback (lower SLA but more capacity), 2) increase Dedicated pool min nodes and scale immediately, 3) enable aggressive prefix caching/soft-ttl for embeddings for that keyspace. Which is feasible fastest?

maria: fastest is (1) reroute to Hosted — low risk and immediate. (2) requires infra changes and capacity approval; can do in ~25-40m. (3) needs model team signoff — might be 30-60m.

ron: I can own the reroute to Hosted and coordinate CS comms. I'll open the fallback route and throttle if we see downstream saturation. I'll ping once done.

devon: ron — when you flip, add a short header in the request: X-Routed-From:dedicated-emergency so we can track requests and billing. Also create a temp alert in Console for PartnerFin error-rate > 2% and p95 latency > 800ms.

ron: will do. Opening the route now. buildbot:deploy?

buildbot: deploy triggered: feature/temporary-reroute -> prod (patch). CI passed.

ron: Reroute live at 03:34 UTC. Early checks: errors dropped from 4.8% -> 0.9% for PartnerFin; p95 latency from 1.6s -> 420ms. Lia, can you ask PartnerFin to validate behaviour on their side?

lia: pinged them; they confirm traffic looks normal and errors dropped. They want estimate for root cause fix and ETA to restore to Dedicated without reroute.

aj: root cause plan: 1) repro high KV miss with synthetic traffic, 2) tune cache eviction and increase pool min nodes to handle hot-key spikes, 3) investigate model v2 memory patterns (possible regressed memory usage after last quant patch). I estimate 3-5 hours for complete fix + QA. Shorter if we accept config changes only (~60-90m).

devon: action items: Ron owns reroute (done). Aj + Maria to own Dedicated recovery. Maria to coordinate infra scaling (start capacity increase now). Aj to run synthetic load and test cache/ejection tuning. Lia to keep PartnerFin updated every 30m. I'll prepare a brief postmortem template and mark this as P1 for tracking.

maria: started scale up at 03:38 UTC, adding 3 nodes to pool A. ETA ~18 minutes for nodes to warm and join.

aj: synthetic load started 03:40 UTC, reproducing tail errors. Testing a cache soft-ttl bump + larger in-memory KV window; will report results in 15m.

devon: thx team. Keep replies short here — just status pings. We'll reconvene if anything changes or after the 18m scale completes. :thumbsup:
